headline: Approved Conditional Use Appeal for 136 Ray ST to convert building into 92-unit multi-family dwelling, 5-0.
summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals met and reviewed a Conditional Use Appeal for 136 Ray ST, submitted by ST J Housing LLC, to convert a nonresidential structure into a 92-unit multi-family dwelling. The Board approved the appeal by a 5-0 vote for a period of three years.
decisions: Approved the Conditional Use Appeal (CU-003679-2026) for 136 Ray ST to convert a nonresidential structure to a 92-unit multi-family dwelling, for a period of three years, by a vote of 5-0.

decision_evidence.quote: The Board voted 5-0 to approve the Conditional Use Appeal for a period of three years.
